title: Consolidate memory periodically against a plain-search baseline
body:
Outcome: a periodic memory consolidation pass (merge, dedupe, retire stale entries) runs for repository memory, and its retrieval quality is compared with a plain-search baseline that the memory design must beat. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/rss-patterns.md ("dreaming" consolidation). Must respect Product ADR 0002 (memory = temporal brain) and memory krn-memory-target; never retire memory blindly.
Proof: an eval prints retrieval accuracy for consolidated memory vs plain search on a fixed question set.
